name: App Store and Google Play Reviews
title: App Store & Google Play Reviews Scraper
uses: Product and growth teams tracking what users say about their app and competitors on both stores
Support teams finding bugs and complaints right after a release
Market researchers mining review text for feature requests and pain points
AI agents summarizing app sentiment from one clean review schema

inputs.name: apps
inputs.title: Apps
inputs.description: One app per line: an app name (e.g. Spotify), an App Store URL or numeric ID, or a Google Play URL or package name (e.g. com.spotify.music). The matching app in the other store is found automatically.

inputs.name: maxReviewsPerStore
inputs.title: Max reviews per app per store
inputs.description: Apple's public review feed returns up to 500 reviews per country. Google Play supports up to 5,000.

inputs.name: country
inputs.title: Country
inputs.description: Two-letter store country code, e.g. us, gb, de, in.

inputs.name: language
inputs.title: Language (Google Play)
inputs.description: Two-letter language code for Google Play reviews.

inputs.name: includeSummary
inputs.title: Add a free summary row per app and store
inputs.description: Adds one uncharged row with the store rating, rating count and the rating distribution of the returned reviews.

description: Scrape app reviews from the Apple App Store and Google Play in one run. Give an app name, URL, ID or package and get ratings, review text, dates, versions and developer replies from both stores in one clean JSON schema. No login, no proxy.
